chunks: And from him, from Al-Hasan, from Zur'ah, from Samaan, who said:

I asked him about the Qunut (supplication in prayer), in which prayer is it? So he said: 'In every thing in which the recitation is made audible, there is Qunut. And the Qunut is before the Ruku' (bowing) and after the recitation.'
ai.seo_question: When and in which prayers should Qunut be recited according to Shia jurisprudence?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* clarifies the procedural timing of Qunut, placing it specifically between the recitation (Qira'ah) and the bowing (Ruku'). It establishes a general principle that Qunut is associated with prayers featuring audible recitation, reflecting the Shia scholarly emphasis on the precise sequence of prayer acts as derived from the Imams.
